newsitem.title: USA: Park-Ohio offers to buy Sudbury.
newsitem.headline: Park-Ohio offers to buy Sudbury.

text.p: Park-Ohio Industries Inc said on Tuesday it has offered to acquire Sudbury Inc for $170 million cash or $11 a share.
The offer will remain outstanding through the close of business on Monday, September 9, 1996, Park Ohio said.

Park-Ohio said in a letter addressed to Sudbury that executives of both companies met on August 22, 1996 to discuss Park-Ohio's offer. Park-Ohio attached the letter to Sudbury's board in its announcement about the merger.
Park-Ohio said it is prepared to meet with Sudbury's entire board of directors to provide the necessary assurances of its interest and bona fides.
While Park-Ohio acknowledged that its bid was made without confidential informantion, the company said it believes its offer to be "full and fair."

Sudbury representatives were not immediately available to comment upon Park-Ohio's claim that Sudbury is considering other takeover offers and that other parties have had access to company information.
Park-Ohio said its commitment to acquire Sudbury is supported by its banks.
Sudbury shares closed at 10-5/8, off 1/8, on 9,400 shares of volume.
Park Ohio shares closed at 14-1/8, off 3/8, on 17,900 shares traded.
